title_zh: AHE v4：怎样让 Agent 根据失败轨迹修改自己的框架
title_en: AHE v4: evolving agent harnesses from failure traces
summary_zh: 从组件文件、分层轨迹到改动预测，解读 AHE 的自动演化流程、迁移效果与退化风险。
summary_en: Editable components, layered traces, and testable predictions in harness evolution, with transfer results and regression risks.

paper.title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses

title_zh: VerifiedLab：从逐字段核验到可追溯的科研推理
title_en: VerifiedLab: from field-level verification to traceable research
summary_zh: 以钙钛矿太阳能电池为例，理解版本化 Skill 如何核验文献记录、支撑时间留出预测，并限定研究智能体可以发布的主张。
summary_en: How versioned Skills verify perovskite literature records, support temporal prediction, and constrain what research agents can claim.

paper.title: VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns

title_zh: HarnessEvolve：怎样用参考轨迹修订 Agent 框架
title_en: HarnessEvolve: revising agent harnesses with reference trajectories
summary_zh: 从同题轨迹对照到质量和性能门控，解读测试集和跨框架迁移结果。
summary_en: Reference traces, quality and performance gates, and cross-framework transfer.

paper.title: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution

title_zh: HarnessDev：Agent 能选出更好的框架版本吗？
title_en: HarnessDev: can agents select better harness versions?
summary_zh: 区分框架创建、可见反馈优化、留出评估和更换执行模型后的表现。
summary_en: Creation, feedback-driven evolution, held-out evaluation, and transfer across runtime models.

paper.title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?

title_zh: Darwin Gödel Machine：为什么要保留暂时变弱的 Agent 版本
title_en: Darwin Gödel Machine: why keep temporarily weaker agents?
summary_zh: 从版本档案和分支搜索理解编码 Agent 自改，区分搜索子集、完整评估与跨基准迁移。
summary_en: Archive-based coding-agent improvement, with search subsets, full evaluation, and cross-benchmark transfer.

paper.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

title_zh: Evo-Harness：Agent 怎样把失败轨迹编成可复用技能
title_en: Evo-Harness: turning failed agent runs into reusable skills
summary_zh: 从失败反思、候选经验到技能库更新，解读五项主实验、训练集技能迁移、在线更新和反馈消融。
summary_en: Failure reflection, skill compilation, five main benchmarks, train-split transfer, online updates, and feedback ablations.

paper.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents

title_zh: SciToolAgent-Evo：科研 Agent 怎样发现并复用新工具
title_en: SciToolAgent-Evo: how research agents acquire and reuse scientific tools
summary_zh: 从成败轨迹积累经验，用 LinUCB 决定搜哪里，再把成功使用的工具写入图谱。解读两项基准、迁移消融和推理成本。
summary_en: Learning from contrasting runs, choosing where to search with LinUCB, and adding successful tools to a graph, with benchmark, ablation, and cost results.

paper.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition

title_zh: 干将 Gan Jiang：让 X 射线衍射分析的经验成为可验证的技能
title_en: Gan Jiang: turning X-ray diffraction analysis into testable skills
summary_zh: 沿候选检索、证据核验、精修和技能回写，解读 DeltaXRDbench 主结果与冻结技能后的留出评估。
summary_en: Candidate retrieval, evidence checks, refinement, and skill revision, with results from DeltaXRDbench and held-out evaluation of frozen workflows.

paper.title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction

title_zh: AutoScientists：科研智能体怎样组队，决定下一次实验
title_en: AutoScientists: how research agents form teams and choose the next experiment
summary_zh: 从共享实验日志、提案互评和停滞后改组，理解自组织团队在相同实验资源下如何搜索，以及试验次数与实际耗时的区别。
summary_en: Shared logs, proposal critique, and team reorganization during experimental search, with a comparison of trial counts, wall-clock time, and budgets.

paper.title: AutoScientists: Self-Organizing Agent Teams for Long-Running Scientific Experimentation

title_zh: AutoSciRub：先明确证据要求，再推进自主科研
title_en: AutoSciRub: specify evidence before improving research
summary_zh: 沿目标骨架、文献与数据依据、准则合成和定向修订流程，解读跨系统收益，以及内部核验、可评分提交与完整科研成功的区别。
summary_en: From goal skeletons and evidence grounding to targeted revision: cross-system gains and the distinctions between internal verification, scorable submissions, and complete research success.

paper.title: Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents

title_zh: EXP-Bench：AI 能把研究实验完整做对吗？
title_en: EXP-Bench: can AI complete a research experiment correctly?
summary_zh: 从 461 个实验任务、过程评分到独立执行，理解单项能力与完整成功的差距，以及 0.5% 严格得分的统计边界。
summary_en: From 461 experimental tasks and process scoring to independent execution: the gap between partial competence and complete success, and the limits of the strict 0.5% result.

paper.title: EXP-Bench: Can AI Conduct AI Research Experiments?

title_zh: ResearchClawBench：完整报告距离可靠科研还有多远
title_en: ResearchClawBench: how far are complete reports from reliable research?
summary_zh: 从隐藏目标、任务输入到加权 RADS 评分，理解科研证据与报告外观的差别；附评分教学算例、可展开说明及与 AutoSciRub 的连接。
summary_en: From hidden targets and task inputs to weighted RADS scoring: scientific evidence, report quality, a labeled teaching example, expandable notes, and the link to AutoSciRub.

paper.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research

title_zh: AstaBench：怎样公平评价科研智能体
title_en: AstaBench: how to evaluate research agents fairly
summary_zh: 从统一任务、受控文献工具到成本与产物核验，理解科研智能体的整体成绩，以及平均步骤得分与完整研究成功率的距离。
summary_en: From standardized tasks and controlled literature tools to costs and artifact checks: interpreting overall scores and the gap between partial progress and complete research.

paper.title: AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite

title_zh: 让 AI 科研系统积累经验：EvoScientist 的双记忆与跨任务演化
title_en: Learning from research experience: EvoScientist’s dual memory and cross-task evolution
summary_zh: 沿构思、实验与经验回写流程，解读双记忆和三种演化机制，区分提案人评、代码成功率与六篇论文录用的证据边界。
summary_en: A reading of dual memory and three evolution mechanisms, separating evidence from proposal judgments, code execution, and six accepted papers.

paper.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

title_zh: AutoSOTA：从论文复现到有效的方法改进
title_en: AutoSOTA: from paper replication to valid method improvements
summary_zh: 沿资源恢复、实验执行与反思优化流程，解读八个 Agent 的分工、105/125 的结果，以及有效性监督和计算成本的边界。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of resource recovery, execution, and iterative optimization, examining eight agents, the 105/125 result, validity supervision, and compute costs.

paper.title: AutoSOTA: An End-to-End Automated Research System for State-of-the-Art AI Model Discovery

title_zh: PaperBench：AI 能把一篇论文真正复现出来吗？
title_en: PaperBench: can AI truly replicate a research paper?
summary_zh: 从代码实现、独立执行到结果匹配，理解论文复现的层级评分，以及科研智能体持续推进实验的瓶颈。
summary_en: From implementation and independent execution to matching results: hierarchical replication scores and the limits of sustained experimental progress.

paper.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI’s Ability to Replicate AI Research

title_zh: FrontierScience：从科学解题到研究子问题评测
title_en: FrontierScience: from science problem solving to research subtasks
summary_zh: 从专家出题、独立复审到 10 分制 rubric，理解竞赛成绩与研究题表现的差异，以及评测分数能说明什么。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of expert task construction, independent review, rubric grading, and the gap between competition scores and research-subtask performance.

paper.title: FrontierScience: Evaluating AI's Ability to Perform Expert-Level Scientific Tasks

title_zh: ScientistOne：用证据链连接论文、代码与实验
title_en: ScientistOne: linking papers, code, and experiments through evidence
summary_zh: 数字来自哪次实验，方法是否对应代码，引用是否真实？沿文献、实验与写作流程，理解证据链和四项产物审计。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of evidence grounding across literature, experiments, and writing, with four artifact integrity checks and their limits.

paper.title: ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence

title_zh: SDE：答对科学题，能否做好科学研究
title_en: SDE: do scientific Q&A scores predict discovery?
summary_zh: 从研究场景、题目测评到多轮项目，理解科学发现能力该怎样评价，以及答题分数何时无法预测研究表现。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of scenario-grounded questions, iterative projects, and the gap between answering science questions and driving discovery.

paper.title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Scientific Discovery

title_zh: ScientistTwo：从研究想法到实验反馈
title_en: ScientistTwo: from research ideas to experimental feedback
summary_zh: 按研究流程读懂自主科研：怎样筛选想法、解释提升，再把评审反馈变成下一步实验。配合原论文方法图与核心实验。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of idea screening, ablation, and review-driven experiments, with the original method figures and core evidence.

paper.title: ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI

title_zh: 从一张 CT 开始，理解 Medical VLM 与 Probe
title_en: Understanding Medical VLMs and probes, one CT slice at a time
summary_zh: 把病灶是否存在、模型如何回答，以及 Probe 读出了什么分开理解，建立医学 VLM 可解释性研究的入门框架。
summary_en: A concrete introduction to lesion labels, native model answers, probe predictions, and what they can—and cannot—establish.

title_zh: DeepRare：罕见病诊断中的工具、证据与可追溯推理
title_en: DeepRare: tools, evidence, and traceable reasoning
summary_zh: 从系统架构、实验与失败案例出发，区分带引用的解释、诊断准确性与真正的临床效用。
summary_en: A reading of the architecture, evaluation, failure modes, and limits of an agentic rare-disease diagnosis system.

paper.title: An agentic system for rare disease diagnosis with traceable reasoning

title_zh: 生成—验证—修复：Coding Agent 的证据闭环
title_en: Generate–Verify–Repair: an evidence loop for coding agents
summary_zh: 从可执行任务包到独立验证、局部修复与干净重放，理解 G–V–R 为什么不只是一次自我反思。
summary_en: From executable task bundles to independent verification, targeted repair, and clean replay.

title_zh: Rubric Construction：让评分规则成为可验证的学习信号
title_en: Rubric construction: from scoring rules to verifiable learning signals
summary_zh: 梳理需求溯源、原子准则、hard gates、过程评价与对抗审计，区分评分一致性和规则本身的有效性。
summary_en: A framework for requirement provenance, atomic criteria, hard gates, process feedback, and adversarial audits.

title_zh: 从静态资料到 Agent 训练数据：指令、动作、环境与奖励
title_en: From static materials to agent training data
summary_zh: 同一份文档或工具记录，怎样逐步增加任务、状态与验证结构，转化为 SFT 和 RL 可用的数据。
summary_en: How task, action, state, and verification structures turn static materials into SFT and RL data.

title_zh: AI 故事生成的领域地图：规划、记忆、交互与评价
title_en: A field guide to AI story generation
summary_zh: 从 Plan-and-Write 到长篇记忆与读者选择，整理生成路线、评价维度和优先阅读清单。
summary_en: A map of long-form planning, narrative memory, interactive choices, and story evaluation.

title_zh: Reflexion：把失败反馈写进记忆
title_en: Reflexion: learning through reflective memory
summary_zh: 不更新模型权重的语言反思，如何影响下一轮行动，以及错误记忆为什么需要被检查。
summary_en: How verbal feedback changes future trials without weight updates, and why reflective memory needs verification.

paper.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

title_zh: CRITIC：让自我修正依靠工具证据
title_en: CRITIC: grounding self-correction in tool evidence
summary_zh: 将初答、外部工具核验与修订连接起来，理解 self-critique 和 tool-grounded critique 的区别。
summary_en: Connecting initial answers, external validation, and revision with auditable tool evidence.

paper.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing

title_zh: Self-Refine：自反馈迭代的能力与边界
title_en: Self-Refine: the promise and limits of self-feedback
summary_zh: 同一个模型扮演生成、反馈与修订角色，是一个简单而重要的推理时优化基线。
summary_en: A useful baseline in which one model generates, critiques, and revises its own output.

paper.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
